text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) comes to a close. 
It seems she was unable to catch up to her 
"friend" once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However—watching Special Week eat well, 
run hard, and pour everything into her 
stride, Manhattan Cafe seemed to sense 
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following conventional strategy, the next 
race would naturally be the spring Grand 
Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Manhattan Cafe stated that, at 
the invitation of her "friend," she would 
take on a major overseas race. Considering 
the condition of her hooves, it was far 
too dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there is a promise to chase after 
her "friend." Keeping the Takarazuka Kinen 
in mind as well, she decided to make the 
final call on the France expedition next 
month.
